items.question: Trong câu "Validation is the activity of ensuring that what you recorded really describes a product that will satisfy the customer needs.", từ "ensure" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Validation is the activity of ensuring that what you recorded really describes a product that will satisfy the customer needs.", what does "ensure" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: ensure /ɪnˈʃʊər/ (động từ): đảm bảo, chắc chắn. "Ensure that ..." = đảm bảo rằng ...; đừng nhầm với "insure" (mua bảo hiểm).
items.explanationEn: ensure /ɪnˈʃʊər/ (verb): to make certain. "Ensure that ..." = make certain that ...; do not confuse it with "insure".

items.question: Trong câu "Validation is the activity of ensuring that what you recorded really describes a product that will satisfy the customer needs.", từ "satisfy" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Validation is the activity of ensuring that what you recorded really describes a product that will satisfy the customer needs.", what does "satisfy" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: satisfy /ˈsæt.ɪs.faɪ/ (động từ): đáp ứng, thỏa mãn. "Satisfy needs/requirements" = đáp ứng nhu cầu/yêu cầu; danh từ "satisfaction".
items.explanationEn: satisfy /ˈsæt.ɪs.faɪ/ (verb): to meet or fulfil. "Satisfy needs or requirements" = meet them; the noun is "satisfaction".

items.question: Trong câu "The cost of fixing a defect grows exponentially with the phase in which it is found.", từ "exponentially" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The cost of fixing a defect grows exponentially with the phase in which it is found.", what does "exponentially" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: exponentially /ˌek.spəˈnen.ʃəl.i/ (trạng từ): theo cấp số nhân. "Grow exponentially" = tăng theo cấp số nhân, càng về sau càng tăng nhanh.
items.explanationEn: exponentially /ˌek.spəˈnen.ʃəl.i/ (adverb): at an ever faster rate. "Grow exponentially" = increase faster and faster over time.

items.question: Trong câu "The cost of fixing a defect grows exponentially with the phase in which it is found.", từ "defect" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The cost of fixing a defect grows exponentially with the phase in which it is found.", what does "defect" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: defect /ˈdiː.fekt/ (danh từ): lỗi, khiếm khuyết. "Find/fix a defect" = tìm/sửa lỗi; động từ "defect" /dɪˈfekt/ lại nghĩa là đào tẩu.
items.explanationEn: defect /ˈdiː.fekt/ (noun): a flaw or error. "Find or fix a defect" is common; the verb "defect" /dɪˈfekt/ means to desert.

items.question: Trong câu "After delivery: the most expensive of all — emergency patches, customer support, damaged reputation, and sometimes legal liability.", từ "liability" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "After delivery: the most expensive of all — emergency patches, customer support, damaged reputation, and sometimes legal liability.", what does "liability" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: liability /ˌlaɪ.əˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (danh từ): trách nhiệm pháp lý. "Legal liability" = trách nhiệm pháp lý (có thể bị kiện, bồi thường).
items.explanationEn: liability /ˌlaɪ.əˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (noun): legal responsibility. "Legal liability" means being legally responsible, for example for damages.

items.question: Trong câu "After delivery: the most expensive of all — emergency patches, customer support, damaged reputation, and sometimes legal liability.", từ "patch" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "After delivery: the most expensive of all — emergency patches, customer support, damaged reputation, and sometimes legal liability.", what does "patch" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a cloth piece over a hole
items.explanation: patch /pætʃ/ (danh từ): bản vá phần mềm. "Emergency/security patch" = bản vá khẩn cấp/bảo mật; động từ "patch a bug".
items.explanationEn: patch /pætʃ/ (noun): a small software fix. An "emergency" or "security patch" fixes urgent problems; the verb is "patch a bug".

items.question: Trong câu "Spelling out the conditions under which the customer will accept the product is itself a powerful form of validation, because it forces everyone to agree on what success means.", từ "spell out" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Spelling out the conditions under which the customer will accept the product is itself a powerful form of validation, because it forces everyone to agree on what success means.", what does "spell out" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: spell out /spel aʊt/ (cụm từ): nói rõ từng điểm. "Spell out the conditions" = nêu rõ ràng, cụ thể các điều kiện, không để ai phải đoán.
items.explanationEn: spell out /spel aʊt/ (phrase): to state in detail. "Spell out the conditions" = state them explicitly so nobody has to guess.

items.question: Trong câu "A peer review is an activity in which people other than the author examine a work product to find defects and improvement opportunities.", từ "examine" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A peer review is an activity in which people other than the author examine a work product to find defects and improvement opportunities.", what does "examine" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: examine /ɪɡˈzæm.ɪn/ (động từ): xem xét kỹ lưỡng. "Examine a document" = đọc và xem xét kỹ để tìm vấn đề; danh từ "examination".
items.explanationEn: examine /ɪɡˈzæm.ɪn/ (verb): to inspect closely. "Examine a document" = look at it carefully for problems; the noun is "examination".

items.question: Trong câu "Review is not one thing — it is a spectrum, from very informal to very formal.", từ "spectrum" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Review is not one thing — it is a spectrum, from very informal to very formal.", what does "spectrum" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: spectrum /ˈspek.trəm/ (danh từ): dải mức độ. "A spectrum from A to B" = một dải liên tục từ A đến B; nghĩa gốc là quang phổ.
items.explanationEn: spectrum /ˈspek.trəm/ (noun): a range between extremes. "A spectrum from A to B" is a continuous range; the literal sense is a band of colours.

items.question: Trong câu "When reviewers are geographically dispersed or schedules do not align", từ "dispersed" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When reviewers are geographically dispersed or schedules do not align", what does "dispersed" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: dispersed /dɪˈspɜːst/ (tính từ): phân tán, rải rác. "Geographically dispersed team" = nhóm ở nhiều nơi khác nhau.
items.explanationEn: dispersed /dɪˈspɜːst/ (adjective): spread out. A "geographically dispersed team" works from many different locations.

items.question: Trong câu "When reviewers are geographically dispersed or schedules do not align", từ "align" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When reviewers are geographically dispersed or schedules do not align", what does "align" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: align /əˈlaɪn/ (động từ): khớp với nhau. "Schedules align" = lịch trùng khớp; "align text left" = căn trái văn bản.
items.explanationEn: align /əˈlaɪn/ (verb): to match up. "Schedules align" when they fit together; "align text left" is a formatting sense.

items.question: Trong câu "The group prepares in advance and then meets to discuss; planned but less ceremonial", từ "ceremonial" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The group prepares in advance and then meets to discuss; planned but less ceremonial", what does "ceremonial" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: ceremonial /ˌser.ɪˈməʊ.ni.əl/ (tính từ): mang tính nghi thức. "Less ceremonial" = ít thủ tục, nghi thức hơn; danh từ "ceremony" (Scrum ceremonies).
items.explanationEn: ceremonial /ˌser.ɪˈməʊ.ni.əl/ (adjective): formal and ritual. "Less ceremonial" means fewer formalities; the noun is "ceremony", as in Scrum ceremonies.

items.question: Trong câu "Only when they sit together and articulate their understanding does the difference emerge.", từ "emerge" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Only when they sit together and articulate their understanding does the difference emerge.", what does "emerge" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: emerge /ɪˈmɜːdʒ/ (động từ): lộ ra, xuất hiện. "A problem emerges" = vấn đề lộ diện; tính từ "emerging" = mới nổi.
items.explanationEn: emerge /ɪˈmɜːdʒ/ (verb): to come out, appear. "A problem emerges" when it becomes visible; "emerging" means newly appearing.

items.question: Trong câu "This is why face-to-face reviews retain irreplaceable value.", từ "irreplaceable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is why face-to-face reviews retain irreplaceable value.", what does "irreplaceable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: irreplaceable /ˌɪr.ɪˈpleɪ.sə.bəl/ (tính từ): không thể thay thế. Tiền tố "ir-" = không; "irreplaceable value" = giá trị không gì thay được.
items.explanationEn: irreplaceable /ˌɪr.ɪˈpleɪ.sə.bəl/ (adjective): impossible to replace. The prefix "ir-" means not; "irreplaceable value" cannot be substituted.

items.question: Trong câu "When the reader paraphrases a requirement in their own words and that interpretation differs from what the author meant, you have just found a real ambiguity — the most dangerous kind, undetectable any other way.", từ "paraphrase" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When the reader paraphrases a requirement in their own words and that interpretation differs from what the author meant, you have just found a real ambiguity — the most dangerous kind, undetectable any other way.", what does "paraphrase" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: paraphrase /ˈpær.ə.freɪz/ (động từ): diễn đạt bằng lời khác. "Paraphrase in your own words" = nói lại theo cách của mình để kiểm tra đã hiểu đúng chưa.
items.explanationEn: paraphrase /ˈpær.ə.freɪz/ (verb): to restate in other words. "Paraphrase in your own words" = restate it your way to check understanding.

items.question: Trong câu "When the reader paraphrases a requirement in their own words and that interpretation differs from what the author meant, you have just found a real ambiguity — the most dangerous kind, undetectable any other way.", từ "interpretation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When the reader paraphrases a requirement in their own words and that interpretation differs from what the author meant, you have just found a real ambiguity — the most dangerous kind, undetectable any other way.", what does "interpretation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: interpretation /ɪnˌtɜː.prɪˈteɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): cách hiểu. "Different interpretations" = các cách hiểu khác nhau; động từ "interpret".
items.explanationEn: interpretation /ɪnˌtɜː.prɪˈteɪ.ʃən/ (noun): a way of understanding. "Different interpretations" are different readings; the verb is "interpret".

items.question: Trong câu "When the reader paraphrases a requirement in their own words and that interpretation differs from what the author meant, you have just found a real ambiguity — the most dangerous kind, undetectable any other way.", từ "undetectable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When the reader paraphrases a requirement in their own words and that interpretation differs from what the author meant, you have just found a real ambiguity — the most dangerous kind, undetectable any other way.", what does "undetectable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: undetectable /ˌʌn.dɪˈtek.tə.bəl/ (tính từ): không phát hiện được. Cấu tạo "un- + detect + -able"; "undetectable error" = lỗi không thể phát hiện.
items.explanationEn: undetectable /ˌʌn.dɪˈtek.tə.bəl/ (adjective): impossible to notice. Built from "un- + detect + -able"; an "undetectable error" cannot be found.

items.question: Trong câu "The moderator determines who attends, splits the document into manageable portions, and checks the entry criteria: is the document complete and clean enough to be worth reviewing?", từ "manageable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The moderator determines who attends, splits the document into manageable portions, and checks the entry criteria: is the document complete and clean enough to be worth reviewing?", what does "manageable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: manageable /ˈmæn.ɪ.dʒə.bəl/ (tính từ): vừa sức xử lý. "Manageable portions/chunks" = các phần đủ nhỏ để xử lý được.
items.explanationEn: manageable /ˈmæn.ɪ.dʒə.bəl/ (adjective): small enough to handle. "Manageable portions" or "chunks" are small enough to deal with.

items.question: Trong câu "Do not review a sloppy draft.", từ "sloppy" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not review a sloppy draft.", what does "sloppy" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: sloppy /ˈslɒp.i/ (tính từ): cẩu thả, luộm thuộm. "Sloppy work/code" = công việc/mã làm ẩu, thiếu cẩn thận.
items.explanationEn: sloppy /ˈslɒp.i/ (adjective): careless and messy. "Sloppy work" or "sloppy code" is done carelessly.

items.question: Trong câu "The meeting is mainly for consolidating, classifying, and surfacing ambiguity through discussion.", từ "consolidate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The meeting is mainly for consolidating, classifying, and surfacing ambiguity through discussion.", what does "consolidate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: consolidate /kənˈsɒl.ɪ.deɪt/ (động từ): gộp lại, tổng hợp. "Consolidate findings" = gộp các phát hiện riêng lẻ thành một danh sách chung.
items.explanationEn: consolidate /kənˈsɒl.ɪ.deɪt/ (verb): to combine into one. "Consolidate findings" = merge separate findings into one list.

items.question: Trong câu "If participants have not prepared, POSTPONE the meeting.", từ "postpone" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If participants have not prepared, POSTPONE the meeting.", what does "postpone" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: postpone /pəʊstˈpəʊn/ (động từ): hoãn lại. "Postpone a meeting" = dời cuộc họp sang lúc khác (không phải hủy).
items.explanationEn: postpone /pəʊstˈpəʊn/ (verb): to delay. "Postpone a meeting" = move it to a later time, not cancel it.

items.question: Trong câu "A list of common defect types — missing exceptions, vague wording, missing verification criteria, contradictions with other requirements — helps reviewers search systematically rather than randomly.", từ "systematically" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A list of common defect types — missing exceptions, vague wording, missing verification criteria, contradictions with other requirements — helps reviewers search systematically rather than randomly.", what does "systematically" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: systematically /ˌsɪs.təˈmæt.ɪ.kəl.i/ (trạng từ): có hệ thống, bài bản. Trái nghĩa "randomly"; "search systematically" = tìm theo phương pháp rõ ràng.
items.explanationEn: systematically /ˌsɪs.təˈmæt.ɪ.kəl.i/ (adverb): methodically. The opposite of "randomly"; "search systematically" means following a clear method.

items.question: Trong câu "Beyond that, concentration collapses and the defect-finding rate drops sharply.", từ "concentration" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Beyond that, concentration collapses and the defect-finding rate drops sharply.", what does "concentration" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: concentration /ˌkɒn.sənˈtreɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự tập trung chú ý. "Lose concentration" = mất tập trung; động từ "concentrate on".
items.explanationEn: concentration /ˌkɒn.sənˈtreɪ.ʃən/ (noun): focused attention. "Lose concentration" = stop focusing; the verb is "concentrate on".

items.question: Trong câu "Not every issue has to be fixed — but every issue must be consciously decided upon.", từ "consciously" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Not every issue has to be fixed — but every issue must be consciously decided upon.", what does "consciously" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: consciously /ˈkɒn.ʃəs.li/ (trạng từ): có ý thức, chủ ý. "Consciously decide" = quyết định một cách có chủ ý, không để trôi qua.
items.explanationEn: consciously /ˈkɒn.ʃəs.li/ (adverb): deliberately, with awareness. "Consciously decide" = make a deliberate choice rather than let it slide.

items.question: Trong câu "Developers — they catch infeasible requirements and missing information needed to implement.", từ "infeasible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Developers — they catch infeasible requirements and missing information needed to implement.", what does "infeasible" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: infeasible /ɪnˈfiː.zə.bəl/ (tính từ): không khả thi. Trái nghĩa "feasible"; "infeasible requirement" = yêu cầu không thể thực hiện.
items.explanationEn: infeasible /ɪnˈfiː.zə.bəl/ (adjective): not achievable. The opposite of "feasible"; an "infeasible requirement" cannot be built.

items.question: Trong câu "This is the most commonly omitted and most valuable group.", từ "omit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is the most commonly omitted and most valuable group.", what does "omit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: omit /əˈmɪt/ (động từ): bỏ sót, bỏ qua. "Omit something" = bỏ ra, không đưa vào; danh từ "omission".
items.explanationEn: omit /əˈmɪt/ (verb): to leave out. "Omit something" = leave it out; the noun is "omission".

items.question: Trong câu "It turns defect-finding from improvisation into a systematic process.", từ "improvisation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It turns defect-finding from improvisation into a systematic process.", what does "improvisation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: improvisation /ˌɪm.prə.vaɪˈzeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự ứng biến tùy hứng. "Improvisation" = làm tùy cơ ứng biến; dễ nhầm với "improvement" (cải tiến).
items.explanationEn: improvisation /ˌɪm.prə.vaɪˈzeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): acting without a plan. "Improvisation" is making it up as you go; do not confuse it with "improvement".

items.question: Trong câu "If you cannot review everything — and you usually cannot — focus on the most complex, most novel, and highest-consequence parts.", từ "novel" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If you cannot review everything — and you usually cannot — focus on the most complex, most novel, and highest-consequence parts.", what does "novel" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: novel /ˈnɒv.əl/ (tính từ): mới lạ, chưa từng có. Tính từ "novel" = mới mẻ; danh từ "novel" = tiểu thuyết.
items.explanationEn: novel /ˈnɒv.əl/ (adjective): new and unfamiliar. The adjective means new and original; the noun means a book of fiction.

items.question: Trong câu "If authors feel attacked, they will become defensive and the value of the review collapses.", từ "defensive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If authors feel attacked, they will become defensive and the value of the review collapses.", what does "defensive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: defensive /dɪˈfen.sɪv/ (tính từ): dễ tự vệ, phòng thủ. "Become defensive" = phản ứng chống chế khi bị góp ý; "defensive programming" = lập trình phòng thủ.
items.explanationEn: defensive /dɪˈfen.sɪv/ (adjective): quick to protect oneself. "Become defensive" = react by protecting yourself; "defensive programming" guards against errors.

items.question: Trong câu "In organizations with a poor culture, being reviewed reads as having your competence questioned.", từ "competence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In organizations with a poor culture, being reviewed reads as having your competence questioned.", what does "competence" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: competence /ˈkɒm.pɪ.təns/ (danh từ): năng lực chuyên môn. Tính từ "competent" = có năng lực; đừng nhầm với "competition".
items.explanationEn: competence /ˈkɒm.pɪ.təns/ (noun): ability, skill. The adjective is "competent"; do not confuse it with "competition".

items.question: Trong câu "You cannot think of any test → the requirement is unverifiable.", từ "unverifiable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You cannot think of any test → the requirement is unverifiable.", what does "unverifiable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unverifiable /ʌnˈver.ɪ.faɪ.ə.bəl/ (tính từ): không kiểm chứng được. Yêu cầu tốt phải "verifiable" – có thể kiểm tra được bằng kiểm thử hoặc quan sát.
items.explanationEn: unverifiable /ʌnˈver.ɪ.faɪ.ə.bəl/ (adjective): impossible to check. A good requirement must be "verifiable", checkable by a test or observation.

items.question: Trong câu "You need many diverse tests → several requirements are probably combined.", từ "diverse" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You need many diverse tests → several requirements are probably combined.", what does "diverse" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: diverse /daɪˈvɜːs/ (tính từ): đa dạng, khác nhau. "Diverse tests/team" = bài test/nhóm đa dạng; danh từ "diversity".
items.explanationEn: diverse /daɪˈvɜːs/ (adjective): varied. "Diverse tests" or a "diverse team" include varied kinds; the noun is "diversity".

items.question: Trong câu "The testing mindset is an extremely effective defect filter applied to requirements.", từ "mindset" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The testing mindset is an extremely effective defect filter applied to requirements.", what does "mindset" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: mindset /ˈmaɪnd.set/ (danh từ): lối tư duy. "Testing mindset" = cách nghĩ của người kiểm thử: luôn hỏi cái gì có thể sai.
items.explanationEn: mindset /ˈmaɪnd.set/ (noun): a way of thinking. A "testing mindset" always asks what could go wrong.

items.question: Trong câu "Three representations — textual requirements, models, and test cases — cross-check each other.", từ "representation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Three representations — textual requirements, models, and test cases — cross-check each other.", what does "representation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: representation /ˌrep.rɪ.zenˈteɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): dạng biểu diễn. "Different representations" = các cách thể hiện cùng một thông tin (văn bản, mô hình, test).
items.explanationEn: representation /ˌrep.rɪ.zenˈteɪ.ʃən/ (noun): a form of depiction. "Different representations" show the same information in other forms (text, models, tests).

items.question: Trong câu "They frequently surface implicit expectations nobody ever said out loud.", từ "implicit" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They frequently surface implicit expectations nobody ever said out loud.", what does "implicit" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: implicit /ɪmˈplɪs.ɪt/ (tính từ): ngầm, không nói ra. Trái nghĩa "explicit"; "implicit requirement" = yêu cầu ngầm ai cũng cho là hiển nhiên.
items.explanationEn: implicit /ɪmˈplɪs.ɪt/ (adjective): unstated, implied. The opposite of "explicit"; an "implicit requirement" is assumed but never stated.

items.question: Trong câu "They frequently surface implicit expectations nobody ever said out loud.", từ "out loud" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They frequently surface implicit expectations nobody ever said out loud.", what does "out loud" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: out loud /aʊt laʊd/ (cụm từ): thành lời. "Say something out loud" = nói thành lời cho người khác nghe.
items.explanationEn: out loud /aʊt laʊd/ (phrase): aloud. "Say something out loud" = speak it so others hear.

items.question: Trong câu "For each user story, the team jointly determines the conditions that must be true for the story to count as done, usually written as tests.", từ "jointly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For each user story, the team jointly determines the conditions that must be true for the story to count as done, usually written as tests.", what does "jointly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: jointly /ˈdʒɔɪnt.li/ (trạng từ): cùng nhau. "Jointly decide/own" = cùng quyết định/cùng sở hữu; tính từ "joint".
items.explanationEn: jointly /ˈdʒɔɪnt.li/ (adverb): together. "Jointly decide" or "jointly own" = do it together; the adjective is "joint".

items.question: Trong câu "For each user story, the team jointly determines the conditions that must be true for the story to count as done, usually written as tests.", từ "count as" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For each user story, the team jointly determines the conditions that must be true for the story to count as done, usually written as tests.", what does "count as" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: count as /kaʊnt æz/ (cụm từ): được coi là. "Count as done" = được tính là hoàn thành (Definition of Done).
items.explanationEn: count as /kaʊnt æz/ (phrase): to be regarded as. "Count as done" = be accepted as finished (the Definition of Done).

items.question: Trong câu "This must be collaborative: the customer or product owner states what matters to them; testers help make it concrete and measurable; developers confirm it is feasible.", từ "measurable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This must be collaborative: the customer or product owner states what matters to them; testers help make it concrete and measurable; developers confirm it is feasible.", what does "measurable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: measurable /ˈmeʒ.ər.ə.bəl/ (tính từ): đo lường được. "Measurable criteria" = tiêu chí có thể đo; "a measurable improvement" = cải thiện thấy rõ.
items.explanationEn: measurable /ˈmeʒ.ər.ə.bəl/ (adjective): able to be measured. "Measurable criteria" can be quantified; "a measurable improvement" is a noticeable one.

items.question: Trong câu "No reinventing what is already known.", từ "reinvent" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "No reinventing what is already known.", what does "reinvent" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reinvent /ˌriː.ɪnˈvent/ (động từ): làm lại từ đầu. Thành ngữ "reinvent the wheel" = mất công làm lại thứ đã có sẵn.
items.explanationEn: reinvent /ˌriː.ɪnˈvent/ (verb): to create again from scratch. The idiom "reinvent the wheel" means wasting effort recreating something that exists.

items.question: Trong câu "Reused requirements have already been reviewed, implemented, and tested in the field — they have been through fire.", từ "in the field" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Reused requirements have already been reviewed, implemented, and tested in the field — they have been through fire.", what does "in the field" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in the field /ɪn ðə fiːld/ (cụm từ): trong thực tế sử dụng. "Tested in the field" = đã được kiểm chứng khi người dùng thật sử dụng.
items.explanationEn: in the field /ɪn ðə fiːld/ (phrase): in real-world use. "Tested in the field" = proven while real users used it.

items.question: Trong câu "Data dictionary definitions — the highest reuse value, because consistency here prevents integration defects across the enterprise.", từ "consistency" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Data dictionary definitions — the highest reuse value, because consistency here prevents integration defects across the enterprise.", what does "consistency" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: consistency /kənˈsɪs.tən.si/ (danh từ): tính nhất quán. "Consistency across products" = các sản phẩm thống nhất cách làm; tính từ "consistent".
items.explanationEn: consistency /kənˈsɪs.tən.si/ (noun): uniformity. "Consistency across products" means they work the same way; the adjective is "consistent".

items.question: Trong câu "Data dictionary definitions — the highest reuse value, because consistency here prevents integration defects across the enterprise.", từ "enterprise" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Data dictionary definitions — the highest reuse value, because consistency here prevents integration defects across the enterprise.", what does "enterprise" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: enterprise /ˈen.tə.praɪz/ (danh từ): doanh nghiệp, tổ chức. "Across the enterprise" = trên toàn tổ chức; "enterprise software" = phần mềm doanh nghiệp.
items.explanationEn: enterprise /ˈen.tə.praɪz/ (noun): a whole business. "Across the enterprise" = throughout the organization; "enterprise software" serves businesses.

items.question: Trong câu "This is exactly why business rules should live in an enterprise repository, not be buried in individual project SRSs.", từ "bury" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is exactly why business rules should live in an enterprise repository, not be buried in individual project SRSs.", what does "bury" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to put a body in a grave
items.explanation: bury /ˈber.i/ (động từ): vùi lấp, giấu kín. "Buried in documents" = bị vùi trong đống tài liệu, khó tìm thấy.
items.explanationEn: bury /ˈber.i/ (verb): to hide among other things. "Buried in documents" = hidden so deep it is hard to find.

items.question: Trong câu "This is exactly why business rules should live in an enterprise repository, not be buried in individual project SRSs.", từ "repository" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is exactly why business rules should live in an enterprise repository, not be buried in individual project SRSs.", what does "repository" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: repository /rɪˈpɒz.ɪ.tər.i/ (danh từ): kho lưu trữ chung. "Repository" = nơi lưu tập trung; trong Git, "repo" là kho mã nguồn.
items.explanationEn: repository /rɪˈpɒz.ɪ.tər.i/ (noun): a central store. A "repository" is a central store; in Git, a "repo" holds source code.

items.question: Trong câu "Glossary terms — an enterprise glossary eliminates each project redefining the same word.", từ "eliminate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Glossary terms — an enterprise glossary eliminates each project redefining the same word.", what does "eliminate" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to knock out of a contest
items.explanation: eliminate /ɪˈlɪm.ɪ.neɪt/ (động từ): loại bỏ hoàn toàn. "Eliminate duplication/waste" = loại bỏ trùng lặp/lãng phí.
items.explanationEn: eliminate /ɪˈlɪm.ɪ.neɪt/ (verb): to remove completely. "Eliminate duplication" or "waste" = get rid of it entirely.

items.question: Trong câu "Nonfunctional requirements and constraints — security standards, compliance regulations, and accessibility requirements are usually identical across products.", từ "identical" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Nonfunctional requirements and constraints — security standards, compliance regulations, and accessibility requirements are usually identical across products.", what does "identical" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: identical /aɪˈden.tɪ.kəl/ (tính từ): giống hệt nhau. "Identical to/across" = giống hệt với/giữa; "identical twins" = sinh đôi cùng trứng.
items.explanationEn: identical /aɪˈden.tɪ.kəl/ (adjective): exactly the same. "Identical to" or "across" means exactly alike; "identical twins" look the same.

items.question: Trong câu "This is the biggest barrier.", từ "barrier" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is the biggest barrier.", what does "barrier" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: barrier /ˈbær.i.ər/ (danh từ): rào cản. "Barrier to reuse/entry" = rào cản đối với tái sử dụng/gia nhập thị trường.
items.explanationEn: barrier /ˈbær.i.ər/ (noun): an obstacle. A "barrier to reuse" or "to entry" is something that blocks it.

items.question: Trong câu "You need provenance and status metadata to build trust.", từ "provenance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You need provenance and status metadata to build trust.", what does "provenance" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: provenance /ˈprɒv.ən.əns/ (danh từ): nguồn gốc xuất xứ. "Provenance" = thông tin nó đến từ đâu, ai viết, qua những gì; giúp tạo lòng tin.
items.explanationEn: provenance /ˈprɒv.ən.əns/ (noun): origin and history. "Provenance" tells where something came from and who made it, which builds trust.

items.question: Trong câu "This needs a bit of culture and a bit of incentive.", từ "incentive" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This needs a bit of culture and a bit of incentive.", what does "incentive" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: incentive /ɪnˈsen.tɪv/ (danh từ): động lực, sự khuyến khích. "Provide an incentive to do something" = tạo động lực (thưởng) để làm gì.
items.explanationEn: incentive /ɪnˈsen.tɪv/ (noun): a motivating reward. "Provide an incentive to do something" = offer a reason or reward to do it.

items.question: Trong câu "Without one, they go stale and trust collapses.", từ "stale" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Without one, they go stale and trust collapses.", what does "stale" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: stale /steɪl/ (tính từ): lỗi thời, cũ. "Go stale" = trở nên cũ, không còn cập nhật; "stale data/cache" = dữ liệu/cache cũ.
items.explanationEn: stale /steɪl/ (adjective): out of date. "Go stale" = become outdated; "stale data" or a "stale cache" is no longer current.

items.question: Trong câu "Copying a requirement into a new project without checking whether it fits injects a subtly wrong requirement — worse than having none, because it looks right.", từ "subtly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Copying a requirement into a new project without checking whether it fits injects a subtly wrong requirement — worse than having none, because it looks right.", what does "subtly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: subtly /ˈsʌt.li/ (trạng từ): tinh vi, khó nhận ra. Chữ "b" câm; "subtly different" = khác biệt rất tinh tế.
items.explanationEn: subtly /ˈsʌt.li/ (adverb): in a hard-to-notice way. The "b" is silent; "subtly different" means different in a small, hard-to-see way.

items.question: Trong câu "Copying a requirement into a new project without checking whether it fits injects a subtly wrong requirement — worse than having none, because it looks right.", từ "inject" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Copying a requirement into a new project without checking whether it fits injects a subtly wrong requirement — worse than having none, because it looks right.", what does "inject" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to give a shot of medicine
items.explanation: inject /ɪnˈdʒekt/ (động từ): đưa vào, cài vào. "Inject a defect" = vô tình đưa lỗi vào; "dependency injection" = tiêm phụ thuộc.
items.explanationEn: inject /ɪnˈdʒekt/ (verb): to introduce into. "Inject a defect" = introduce one; "dependency injection" is a design technique.

items.question: Trong câu "Building a reuse repository costs effort before it pays off.", từ "pay off" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Building a reuse repository costs effort before it pays off.", what does "pay off" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: pay off /peɪ ɒf/ (cụm từ): mang lại lợi ích. "The effort pays off" = công sức được đền đáp; "pay off a loan" = trả hết khoản vay.
items.explanationEn: pay off /peɪ ɒf/ (phrase): to bring good results. "The effort pays off" = it brings results; "pay off a loan" = repay it fully.

items.question: Trong câu "It needs organizational commitment, not just project-level commitment.", từ "commitment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It needs organizational commitment, not just project-level commitment.", what does "commitment" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: commitment /kəˈmɪt.mənt/ (danh từ): sự cam kết. "Management commitment" = sự cam kết, ủng hộ lâu dài của lãnh đạo.
items.explanationEn: commitment /kəˈmɪt.mənt/ (noun): dedication, pledge. "Management commitment" is long-term dedication and support from leaders.

items.question: Trong câu "The key distinction: Reusing a requirement statement gives you content.", từ "distinction" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The key distinction: Reusing a requirement statement gives you content.", what does "distinction" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: distinction /dɪˈstɪŋk.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự phân biệt, khác biệt. "Make/draw a distinction between A and B" = phân biệt A và B.
items.explanationEn: distinction /dɪˈstɪŋk.ʃən/ (noun): a difference between things. "Make or draw a distinction between A and B" = point out how they differ.

items.question: Trong câu "The considerations commonly overlooked — exceptions, limits, interactions.", từ "overlook" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The considerations commonly overlooked — exceptions, limits, interactions.", what does "overlook" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: overlook /ˌəʊ.vəˈlʊk/ (động từ): bỏ sót, không để ý. "Commonly overlooked" = thường bị bỏ sót; nghĩa khác: "a room overlooking the sea".
items.explanationEn: overlook /ˌəʊ.vəˈlʊk/ (verb): to fail to notice. "Commonly overlooked" = often missed; another sense: "a room overlooking the sea".

items.question: Trong câu "Example specimens for reference.", từ "specimen" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Example specimens for reference.", what does "specimen" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: specimen /ˈspes.ə.mɪn/ (danh từ): mẫu, ví dụ mẫu. "Specimen" = một mẫu tiêu biểu để tham khảo; dễ nhầm với "specification".
items.explanationEn: specimen /ˈspes.ə.mɪn/ (noun): a sample example. A "specimen" is a typical sample for reference; do not confuse it with "specification".

items.question: Trong câu "how long it is retained, who can view it, whether it is editable", từ "retain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "how long it is retained, who can view it, whether it is editable", what does "retain" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: retain /rɪˈteɪn/ (động từ): lưu giữ. "Data retention period" = thời gian lưu giữ dữ liệu; danh từ "retention".
items.explanationEn: retain /rɪˈteɪn/ (verb): to keep. The "data retention period" is how long data is kept; the noun is "retention".

items.question: Trong câu "This is why estimates given before there are requirements — which management routinely demands — are always seriously wrong.", từ "routinely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is why estimates given before there are requirements — which management routinely demands — are always seriously wrong.", what does "routinely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: routinely /ruːˈtiːn.li/ (trạng từ): thường xuyên như lệ. "Routinely do something" = làm việc đó thường xuyên như một thói quen.
items.explanationEn: routinely /ruːˈtiːn.li/ (adverb): regularly, as usual. "Routinely do something" = do it regularly as a matter of habit.

items.question: Trong câu "Add contingency for uncertainty, proportional to how stable the requirements are.", từ "contingency" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Add contingency for uncertainty, proportional to how stable the requirements are.", what does "contingency" (noun) mean?
options: sự việc có thể xảy ra
items.explanation: contingency /kənˈtɪn.dʒən.si/ (danh từ): khoản dự phòng. "Contingency buffer/plan" = khoản đệm/kế hoạch dự phòng cho rủi ro.
items.explanationEn: contingency /kənˈtɪn.dʒən.si/ (noun): a reserve for surprises. A "contingency buffer" or "plan" is kept ready for risks.

items.question: Trong câu "Add contingency for uncertainty, proportional to how stable the requirements are.", từ "proportional" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Add contingency for uncertainty, proportional to how stable the requirements are.", what does "proportional" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: proportional /prəˈpɔː.ʃən.əl/ (tính từ): tương xứng với. "Proportional to X" = tỷ lệ thuận, tương xứng với X.
items.explanationEn: proportional /prəˈpɔː.ʃən.əl/ (adjective): in matching amount. "Proportional to X" = changing in line with X.

items.question: Trong câu "An estimate without a requirements baseline is a promise with no foundation.", từ "baseline" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An estimate without a requirements baseline is a promise with no foundation.", what does "baseline" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the back line of a court
items.explanation: baseline /ˈbeɪs.laɪn/ (danh từ): mốc cơ sở đã chốt. "Requirements baseline" = bộ yêu cầu đã được duyệt làm mốc; động từ "baseline" = chốt.
items.explanationEn: baseline /ˈbeɪs.laɪn/ (noun): an agreed reference point. A "requirements baseline" is the approved set used as reference; "to baseline" = to freeze it.

items.question: Trong câu "The lesson: do not make firm commitments at the wide end of the cone.", từ "firm" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The lesson: do not make firm commitments at the wide end of the cone.", what does "firm" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: firm /fɜːm/ (tính từ): chắc chắn, dứt khoát. "Firm commitment/deadline" = cam kết/hạn chót chắc chắn; danh từ "firm" = công ty.
items.explanationEn: firm /fɜːm/ (adjective): fixed, definite. A "firm commitment" or "deadline" is fixed; the noun "firm" means a company.

items.question: Trong câu "After vision and scope: the range narrows considerably.", từ "considerably" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "After vision and scope: the range narrows considerably.", what does "considerably" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: considerably /kənˈsɪd.ər.ə.bli/ (trạng từ): đáng kể. "Considerably" = nhiều, đáng kể; khác "considerately" = một cách chu đáo.
items.explanationEn: considerably /kənˈsɪd.ər.ə.bli/ (adverb): significantly. "Considerably" means by a lot; "considerately" means thoughtfully.

items.question: Trong câu "But do not pretend the boundary is absolute.", từ "absolute" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "But do not pretend the boundary is absolute.", what does "absolute" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: absolute /ˈæb.sə.luːt/ (tính từ): tuyệt đối, cứng nhắc. Trái nghĩa "relative"; "absolute truth" = sự thật tuyệt đối.
items.explanationEn: absolute /ˈæb.sə.luːt/ (adjective): total and fixed. The opposite of "relative"; "absolute truth" allows no exceptions.

items.question: Trong câu "But do not pretend the boundary is absolute.", từ "boundary" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "But do not pretend the boundary is absolute.", what does "boundary" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: boundary /ˈbaʊn.dər.i/ (danh từ): ranh giới. "The boundary between A and B" = ranh giới giữa A và B; "boundary value testing".
items.explanationEn: boundary /ˈbaʊn.dər.i/ (noun): a dividing line. "The boundary between A and B" separates them; see also "boundary value testing".

items.question: Trong câu "Requirements for performance, scalability, security, and portability determine the architecture shape, while functional requirements can usually be implemented in many architectures.", từ "portability" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Requirements for performance, scalability, security, and portability determine the architecture shape, while functional requirements can usually be implemented in many architectures.", what does "portability" (noun) mean?
options: khả năng mở rộng quy mô
khả năng chạy nhiều nền tảng
items.explanation: portability /ˌpɔː.təˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (danh từ): khả năng chạy nhiều nền tảng. "Portability" = phần mềm dễ chuyển sang hệ điều hành/môi trường khác; tính từ "portable".
items.explanationEn: portability /ˌpɔː.təˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (noun): running on other platforms. "Portability" is how easily software moves to another OS or environment; the adjective is "portable".

items.question: Trong câu "Requirements should avoid imposing unnecessary design constraints.", từ "impose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Requirements should avoid imposing unnecessary design constraints.", what does "impose" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: impose /ɪmˈpəʊz/ (động từ): áp đặt. "Impose a constraint/limit on" = áp đặt ràng buộc/giới hạn lên cái gì.
items.explanationEn: impose /ɪmˈpəʊz/ (verb): to force upon. "Impose a constraint" or "limit on" something = force it upon that thing.

items.question: Trong câu "Every line of code should trace back to a requirement.", từ "trace back" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every line of code should trace back to a requirement.", what does "trace back" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to go to the previous page
to link back to a source
items.explanation: trace back /treɪs bæk/ (cụm từ): truy ngược về nguồn. "Trace back to" = có thể lần ngược về nguồn gốc; danh từ "traceability".
items.explanationEn: trace back /treɪs bæk/ (phrase): to link back to a source. "Trace back to" = be linked to an origin; the related noun is "traceability".

items.question: Trong câu "Gold plating is a more serious problem than most people realise.", từ "gold plating" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Gold plating is a more serious problem than most people realise.", what does "gold plating" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: gold plating /ˌɡəʊld ˈpleɪ.tɪŋ/ (cụm từ): thêm tính năng thừa. Nghĩa bóng trong quản lý dự án: tự thêm tính năng không ai yêu cầu, gây tốn chi phí.
items.explanationEn: gold plating /ˌɡəʊld ˈpleɪ.tɪŋ/ (phrase): adding unrequested extras. In project management, it means adding features nobody asked for, which costs money.

items.question: Trong câu "It consumes resources that should have gone to what customers actually need.", từ "consume" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It consumes resources that should have gone to what customers actually need.", what does "consume" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: consume /kənˈsjuːm/ (động từ): tiêu tốn, sử dụng hết. "Consume resources/memory" = tiêu tốn tài nguyên/bộ nhớ; danh từ "consumption".
items.explanationEn: consume /kənˈsjuːm/ (verb): to use up. "Consume resources" or "memory" = use them up; the noun is "consumption".

items.question: Trong câu "Only tests derived from requirements catch that.", từ "derive" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Only tests derived from requirements catch that.", what does "derive" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: derive /dɪˈraɪv/ (động từ): bắt nguồn, suy ra. "Be derived from X" = được tạo ra/suy ra từ X; "derived class" = lớp dẫn xuất.
items.explanationEn: derive /dɪˈraɪv/ (verb): to obtain from a source. "Be derived from X" = come from X; a "derived class" inherits from another.

items.question: Trong câu "Which tests trace to no requirement → either a superfluous test or an unrecorded requirement.", từ "superfluous" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Which tests trace to no requirement → either a superfluous test or an unrecorded requirement.", what does "superfluous" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: superfluous /suːˈpɜː.flu.əs/ (tính từ): thừa, không cần. "Superfluous" = dư thừa, có cũng như không; đồng nghĩa "redundant".
items.explanationEn: superfluous /suːˈpɜː.flu.əs/ (adjective): unnecessary, extra. "Superfluous" means more than needed; a synonym is "redundant".

items.question: Trong câu "Which requirements have no test → a testing gap.", từ "gap" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Which requirements have no test → a testing gap.", what does "gap" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: gap /ɡæp/ (danh từ): lỗ hổng, chỗ thiếu. "Testing/skill gap" = khoảng thiếu hụt trong kiểm thử/kỹ năng.
items.explanationEn: gap /ɡæp/ (noun): a missing part. A "testing gap" or "skill gap" is something missing that should be there.

items.question: Trong câu "almost always gets a meaningless answer unless it is anchored to requirements.", từ "anchor" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "almost always gets a meaningless answer unless it is anchored to requirements.", what does "anchor" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: anchor /ˈæŋ.kər/ (động từ): gắn với, dựa trên. "Anchored to X" = bám vào X làm điểm tựa; danh từ "anchor" = mỏ neo.
items.explanationEn: anchor /ˈæŋ.kər/ (verb): to tie to a reference. "Anchored to X" = fixed to X as a reference; the noun "anchor" holds a ship.

items.question: Trong câu "How many requirements are still TBD or under dispute?", từ "dispute" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How many requirements are still TBD or under dispute?", what does "dispute" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: dispute /dɪˈspjuːt/ (danh từ): tranh cãi, tranh chấp. "Under dispute" = đang bị tranh cãi, chưa thống nhất.
items.explanationEn: dispute /dɪˈspjuːt/ (noun): disagreement. "Under dispute" = still being argued about, not yet agreed.

items.question: Trong câu "Unavailable stakeholders → requirements based on guesswork.", từ "guesswork" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Unavailable stakeholders → requirements based on guesswork.", what does "guesswork" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: guesswork /ˈɡes.wɜːk/ (danh từ): sự phỏng đoán. "Based on guesswork" = dựa trên phỏng đoán chứ không có thông tin thật.
items.explanationEn: guesswork /ˈɡes.wɜːk/ (noun): guessing, not facts. "Based on guesswork" = relying on guesses rather than real information.

items.question: Trong câu "Unstable requirements (scope creep) → never being able to finish.", từ "scope creep" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Unstable requirements (scope creep) → never being able to finish.", what does "scope creep" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: scope creep /ˈskəʊp kriːp/ (cụm từ): phạm vi phình to dần. "Scope creep" = phạm vi dự án cứ lớn dần do thêm yêu cầu không kiểm soát.
items.explanationEn: scope creep /ˈskəʊp kriːp/ (phrase): scope growing unchecked. "Scope creep" happens when uncontrolled new requirements keep enlarging a project.

items.question: Trong câu "Every one of these risks is mitigated by exactly the practices covered throughout this course: structured elicitation, analysis models, clear specification, review, prioritization, and change management.", từ "mitigate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every one of these risks is mitigated by exactly the practices covered throughout this course: structured elicitation, analysis models, clear specification, review, prioritization, and change management.", what does "mitigate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: mitigate /ˈmɪt.ɪ.ɡeɪt/ (động từ): giảm nhẹ. "Mitigate a risk" = giảm khả năng xảy ra hoặc mức ảnh hưởng của rủi ro.
items.explanationEn: mitigate /ˈmɪt.ɪ.ɡeɪt/ (verb): to lessen. "Mitigate a risk" = reduce its likelihood or impact.

items.question: Trong câu "Every one of these risks is mitigated by exactly the practices covered throughout this course: structured elicitation, analysis models, clear specification, review, prioritization, and change management.", từ "elicitation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every one of these risks is mitigated by exactly the practices covered throughout this course: structured elicitation, analysis models, clear specification, review, prioritization, and change management.", what does "elicitation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: elicitation /iˌlɪs.ɪˈteɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự khai thác thông tin. "Requirements elicitation" = thu thập, khai thác yêu cầu từ các bên liên quan; động từ "elicit".
items.explanationEn: elicitation /iˌlɪs.ɪˈteɪ.ʃən/ (noun): drawing out information. "Requirements elicitation" draws requirements out of stakeholders; the verb is "elicit".

items.question: Trong câu "A brilliant requirements document sitting in a drawer has no value.", từ "brilliant" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A brilliant requirements document sitting in a drawer has no value.", what does "brilliant" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: brilliant /ˈbrɪl.jənt/ (tính từ): xuất sắc. "A brilliant idea/document" = ý tưởng/tài liệu xuất sắc; nghĩa gốc là sáng chói.
items.explanationEn: brilliant /ˈbrɪl.jənt/ (adjective): excellent. "A brilliant idea" or "document" is excellent; the literal sense is very bright.

items.question: Trong câu "Handing documents out for solo reading is NOT a group review — ambiguity surfaces only when people articulate their understanding.", từ "solo" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Handing documents out for solo reading is NOT a group review — ambiguity surfaces only when people articulate their understanding.", what does "solo" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: solo /ˈsəʊ.ləʊ/ (tính từ): một mình. "Solo reading/work" = đọc/làm một mình, không có người khác.
items.explanationEn: solo /ˈsəʊ.ləʊ/ (adjective): alone. "Solo reading" or "work" is done by one person alone.

items.question: Trong câu "Writing test cases from requirements before coding immediately exposes unverifiable, combined, or under-specified requirements.", từ "under-specified" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Writing test cases from requirements before coding immediately exposes unverifiable, combined, or under-specified requirements.", what does "under-specified" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: under-specified /ˌʌn.dəˈspes.ɪ.faɪd/ (tính từ): mô tả chưa đủ. Tiền tố "under-" = chưa đủ; "under-specified" = thiếu chi tiết để làm theo.
items.explanationEn: under-specified /ˌʌn.dəˈspes.ɪ.faɪd/ (adjective): described too thinly. The prefix "under-" means not enough; "under-specified" lacks the detail needed.

items.question: Trong câu "Every reused requirement must be reviewed in its new context — mechanical copying injects subtle defects.", từ "mechanical" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every reused requirement must be reviewed in its new context — mechanical copying injects subtle defects.", what does "mechanical" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: mechanical /məˈkæn.ɪ.kəl/ (tính từ): máy móc, rập khuôn. "Mechanical copying" = sao chép máy móc, không suy nghĩ; nghĩa gốc: thuộc về máy móc.
items.explanationEn: mechanical /məˈkæn.ɪ.kəl/ (adjective): done without thought. "Mechanical copying" is done without thinking; the literal sense relates to machines.

items.question: Trong câu "Gold plating consumes resources forever — a feature nobody asked for still has to be maintained indefinitely.", từ "indefinitely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Gold plating consumes resources forever — a feature nobody asked for still has to be maintained indefinitely.", what does "indefinitely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: indefinitely /ɪnˈdef.ɪ.nət.li/ (trạng từ): vô thời hạn. "Postpone/maintain indefinitely" = hoãn/duy trì không có ngày kết thúc.
items.explanationEn: indefinitely /ɪnˈdef.ɪ.nət.li/ (adverb): with no time limit. "Postpone" or "maintain indefinitely" = with no end date.

items.question: Trong câu "Requirements reuse saves time and raises quality, but demands a searchable repository, an owner, and the discipline to re-review in the new context.", từ "discipline" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Requirements reuse saves time and raises quality, but demands a searchable repository, an owner, and the discipline to re-review in the new context.", what does "discipline" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: discipline /ˈdɪs.ə.plɪn/ (danh từ): tính kỷ luật. "The discipline to do something" = đủ kỷ luật để làm đều đặn; nghĩa khác: một ngành học.
items.explanationEn: discipline /ˈdɪs.ə.plɪn/ (noun): self-control, consistency. "The discipline to do something" = the self-control to keep doing it; also means a field of study.
